'''Yarrku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] from whom [[Nyo]] tried to buy passage from to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Night Raider]]'' before [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] offered to take him for a cheaper price.<ref name="TLH" /> In the year [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he was later hired by [[Doune]] to capture Vo-Shay and the ''[[Ashanda Ray]]'' in order to retrieve the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he had lost in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with Vo-Shay. Yarrku was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when he thought the ''Ray'' cornered and being fired upon by three [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="TLH" />
